$description: Light-theme brand roles for the products' shared brand family. Product contexts map semantic roles onto these, so one product file works in every theme.

strong.$description: Filled brand surfaces such as primary buttons.

text.$description: Brand-colored text and links on surfaces.

border.$description: Brand outlines; at least 3:1 against panels.

glow.$description: Translucent halo around a border-colored indicator.
